newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Surgical promotes three officers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Surgical promotes three officers.

text.p: U.S. Surgical Corp Friday said Robert Knarr was named executive vice president, sales and marketing, North America; chief financial officer Richard Douville was named senior vice president; and Jeffrey Sciallo was named vice president, information services and treasurer.
Knarr has been senior vice president and general manager, United States and Canada, since 1994.
Douville joined USS in 1993 as vice president and treasurer and was promoted to the additional position of chief financial officer in 1996.
Sciallo has served as vice president, information services, since 1995.
